name: Morning hip opener
description: Gentle hip flexor and glute holds, breathing slowly into each side for thirty seconds.

name: Shoulder and chest release
description: Open the chest with clasped hands behind your back, and let the shoulders drop away from your ears.

name: Hamstring reach flow
description: Fold forward from the hips with a soft bend in the knees, holding each reach without bouncing.

name: Seated spinal twist
description: Sit tall, rotate gently to one side with the chest leading, and hold, then switch sides.

name: Deep hip and groin stretch
description: Ease into a wide stance and hold each side for about thirty seconds, keeping the spine long.

name: Pigeon pose hold
description: Rest the front shin across the mat and fold forward over the leg, breathing into the outer hip.

name: Full-body recovery stretch
description: A slow sequence through neck, shoulders, back, hips, and legs, with a long breath in each hold.

name: Side body reach
description: Reach one arm overhead and lean gently to the opposite side, stretching the ribs and waist.

name: Standing forward fold
description: Let your head and arms hang forward with knees soft, then roll up one vertebra at a time.
